decision.reason: [ev-0dcc5d469a15] is only a table-of-contents link under "Removed features" in the v2 upgrade guide that names "ControllerConfig type" and points to an anchored section. It shows the type was removed. It does not give the API group/version or kind precisely enough to type the subject, or say how exposed environments are detected. It also does not say what happens to existing ControllerConfig objects or package references to them, or what replaces them. The linked #controllerconfig-type section of the same guide needs to be cited to decide subject, applicability and consequence.
